statements.statement: The patient has a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
The patient has recurrent episodes of supraventricular tachycardia
The patient experiences palpitations and lightheadedness
The service is to correlate intermittent symptoms with underlying arrhythmias
The service is to assess the efficacy of current rate-control therapy
The diagnoses addressed are G45.9 and I47.1
The claim was denied under reason code CO-22
